status_vocabulary.SHARED_EXACT: The same typed construction is defined before a carrier-specific metric/reality choice.
status_vocabulary.SHARED_CONDITIONAL: The schema is common after separately declared auxiliary structure.
status_vocabulary.SHARED_SCHEMA_PORT_REQUIRED: The formal expression is common but its pairing, adjoint, density, or operator realization must be rebuilt per branch.
status_vocabulary.BRANCH_NATIVE_PORT: An analogue exists on every branch but is not the same operator and needs an explicit intertwiner/port.
status_vocabulary.ACTIVE_BUILT_OTHER_BRANCHES_OPEN: The active (9,5) object is built; no lawful transfer to the other branches is claimed.
status_vocabulary.COMPLEX_CONTAINER_ONLY: Only the common complex object is shared; physical real/reality data remain unselected.

primitives.name: underlying metric-bundle vertical sequence
primitives.formula: 0 -> VY -> TY -> pi*TX -> 0; VY=Sym2 T*X

primitives.name: tautological metric musical

primitives.carrier_dependence: depends on the branch base metric and its sign convention
primitives.wave2_use: type connection/section contractions separately

primitives.name: horizontal Zorro split
primitives.formula: Z_(h,nabla)(v,alpha)=v+hor_nabla(sharp_h alpha)
primitives.carrier_dependence: requires a declared connection and naturality group; not canonical from bare X
primitives.wave2_use: common schema with charged connection ownership

primitives.name: four-dimensional trace reversal
primitives.formula: tau_h(k)=k-(1/2)tr_h(k)h; tau_h^2=1

primitives.wave2_use: shared symmetric-fibre involution

primitives.name: vertical DeWitt or sign-reversed metric

primitives.name: volume density and Hodge operator

primitives.wave2_use: rebuild density and integration-by-parts tables

primitives.name: Clifford multiplication
primitives.formula: c_G(xi)c_G(eta)+c_G(eta)c_G(xi)=2G^{-1}(xi,eta)
primitives.carrier_dependence: M(64,H) versus M(128,R); common only after complexification
primitives.wave2_use: rebuild spinor and principal-symbol realizations

primitives.name: Krein or invariant spinor pairing
